Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — Maya plans ~10-week sabbatical in Bali (working ~10 hrs/wk for a US client, paid to her personally). Question: does WFH stipend continue and any employer tax obligations?
Maya Patel: Dates 2026-05-22 -> 2026-08-01. Home base remains OR, payroll to same US bank. Client pays me via Stripe to my personal account.
Marco (Payroll): Need exact dates (got them). Will run country risk check for Indonesia re: employer reporting/withholding. Also confirm bank/currency unchanged — yes.
Priya (Legal): High-level: Indonesia has residency and source-of-income rules; <90 days usually low risk but local regs can still trigger withholding or registration. Will loop APAC counsel if payroll flags risk.
Jon (Benefits): Policy: stipend continues for temporary remote work that doesn't change home base; notification >30 days required. Manager sign-off needed.
Devon (Manager): I approve stipend pending payroll/legal checks.
Marco (Payroll): Action items: 1) country risk note (posting by EOD tomorrow), 2) confirm no banking compliance issues. FYI local authorities sometimes ask for employer registration even for short stints.
Priya (Legal): Advise Maya not to represent Redwood or invoice under company while abroad. I'll get counsel read in ~48h.
Ava (People Ops): Maya please submit short-term remote form; manager approve. Payroll/Legal please post flags within 48h. We'll hold stipend changes until confirmed.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder -> https://redwood-internal/self-serve/remote-form
Maya Patel: Submitted form and attached client retainer (personal).
Marco (Payroll): Received form; running check.
Priya (Legal): Looping in APAC counsel now. Options if risk > low: stagger travel, reduce client work, or temporary payroll withholding.
Ava (People Ops): Next steps recap: payroll country risk note (EOD), legal counsel read (48h), manager already approved form, Maya to avoid invoicing as Redwood. Reconvene after reports.
Maya Patel: Thanks — I'll pause invoicing until confirmed.
PeopleOpsBot: Thread archived after inactivity.
